reason: The 30-row Pro evidence judge failed the post-type floor and the sole supported event. Saved candidates show that the stable prompt-v10 base already passes rare labels and product-label exactness, while most exact-set variation comes from eight common overlapping post types and ideas_requests. This consumed-development probe asks one short Flash audit to decide only those measured dimensions, leaving the stronger base outcome, scalars, rare types, and other product labels unchanged.

cohort.selection: fixed-seed 40 each en/zh-cn/ja from the consumed 500-row development cohort

prompt.source_envelope: candidate-blind source fields plus one saved prompt-v10 proposal; no gold labels, strata, source roles, or source hints

decision_rule: Deterministically replace the eight named prompt-v10 post-type decisions and ideas_requests with these checks; retain every other prompt-v10 field. Continue only if all 120 rows validate, overall and each-locale exact post-type sets reach at least 0.70, overall exact product-label sets reach at least 0.85 and each locale reaches at least 0.70, outcome accuracy remains at least 0.90, context_missing precision/recall remain at least 0.50 when supported, and every supported post/product label F1 meets its unchanged floor. No after-the-fact per-language or per-label source selector is allowed for this probe.
global_stop: The transport reserves worst-case input, output, and dollar capacity before every attempt, refuses request thirteen or attempt twenty-five, and allows at most one transport repeat per ten-row request. Capacity cannot transfer to another lane, prompt, cohort, or provider; any malformed semantic response stops the probe without a new repair lane.
